response.explanation: At line 10, src/presentation/app.ts imports both the `Gateways` type and the `createGateways` factory directly from src/persistence/gateways.ts. It uses them in two places. First, `createApp` defaults its parameter to `createGateways()` (line 16). Second, `buildApp` takes a `Gateways` instance and passes it to `new WeatherService(repos, gateways)` (lines 20 and 28). So the presentation module also acts as the composition root: it builds persistence-layer gateways itself and threads them into the business layer. FF-S03 flags this because presentation should only depend on the layer directly below it (business). Reaching past business into persistence ties the HTTP layer to persistence's types and construction details. Line 11 does the same thing with `createRepositories` from ../persistence/repositories, so this edge is part of a wider wiring pattern, not a one-off. The materials I was given contain no docs, ADRs or comments, so I can't tell whether this placement of the wiring was intended.
